content:
Ava: Heads up — AtlasTech emailed about a split shipment for the 40x A100 order. They can do 12 by air in 7-10 days (DDP option), remainder by sea in 28-35 days. Need decision on air DDP vs standard terms. AWB and BL pending.

Miguel: Can we accept split? We're at ~90% of projected Q2 capacity, so 12 sooner helps. Note: Atlas quoted an air surcharge of +$1.8k/unit if standard terms. Need finance sign-off.

Priya: Oof — $1.8k is high. Can we push back to $1k? If negotiation fails, propose expediting only the critical 12 and sea the rest.

Liam: Logistics note: partial shipments = two import entries, extra customs clearance fees, and possible short-term storage. I can consolidate docs into a master invoice if Atlas can issue one, but I need exact SKU/serial splits. AtlasTech, can you confirm packing approach and whether you'll produce a consolidated commercial invoice?

AtlasTech (vendor): We can split by serial range and issue a single master commercial invoice referencing two AWBs/one BL. Tentative Air AWB: 1ZAA123456789. Sea booking: BL# ATX-BL-98765. Surcharge is driven by fuel and limited belly space — $1.8k is list. If you sign DDP for the air leg we can reduce to $1.2k/unit.

Ava: DDP for air would be preferable to avoid customs lag and reduce release variance. Miguel/Priya — accept DDP at $1.2k for up to 12 units?

Priya: Approve DDP for up to 12 units at $1.2k/unit. Remaining 28 units go by sea at standard price. Need an amended PO and updated proforma before we accept the surcharge.

Miguel: Allocation plan: 12 -> priority pool (west-us-west-2), 28 -> general reserve. Update provisioning tags so autoscaler doesn’t assign low-priority jobs to the incoming air units.

Liam: I'll prep customs entries, request curbside release for the air AWB, and book bonded yard space. rma-bot — please log two customs entries expected.

rma-bot: Recorded: split-shipment; AWB 1ZAA123456789 (air, 12 units, DDP), BL ATX-BL-98765 (sea, 28 units). Please verify sea unit count in final PO.

Ava: Confirming sea count: 40 total - 12 air = 28 sea. Good catch.

Priya: Priya again — PO amendment should state: 12 units air DDP @ base unit price + $1.2k surcharge, 28 units sea @ base unit price, payment terms unchanged. Send proforma before we process payment / release credit.

AtlasTech (vendor): Will issue amended PO/proforma by EOD today. ETA for air customs release 48-72 hours after landing once docs cleared; sea has +/-7 day window. We'll also provide the packing list CSV and tentative cartons mapping.

Miguel: One more ops ask: can Atlas pre-assign serials for the 12 air units so we can pre-register firmware images and pre-seed hostnames? That saves 12h of setup on arrival.

AtlasTech (vendor): Yes — will provide reserved serial list within 24 hours and include a packing_list.csv with serial->carton mapping.

Liam: Thanks — I'll create the ShipIt task and route the air AWB to our bonded yard. Also will add customs codes and storage contingency. :thumbsup:

Ava: OK moving forward with 12 air DDP @ $1.2k surcharge, 28 sea standard. I'll flag the Dedicated pool capacity so we don't auto-scale into those new GPUs until labeled. End of thread.
